functions.name: gists
functions.description: Canonical current gists keyed by opaque gist ID. Typed file maps retain content, encoding and truncation. Owner is distinct from comment authors and revision committers. Pinned detail creation/update fields are unformatted strings and remain raw text; no unsupported timestamp conversion. Deprecated embedded forks/history are replaced by paginated child routes.

metrics.name: gist_count
metrics.comment: Canonical current gists, regardless of lookup/discovery route. Secret visibility follows the caller. Counts exclude historical revisions.

public_gist_count.comment: Selected current gists explicitly marked public.

truncated_gist_count.comment: Selected gist snapshots flagged truncated by GitHub; content is never advertised as fully downloaded.

metrics.name: gist_revision_count
metrics.comment: Gist-qualified immutable revision identities discovered through the complete commit listing and hydrated by exact SHA; an absent optional SHA filter returns zero.

gist_revision_additions.comment: Reported line changes for selected gist revision records; missing upstream counters are not invented. Empty selected populations yield zero; an observed population with no reported values yields NULL. Mixed populations sum only reported values.

gist_revision_deletions.comment: Reported line changes for selected gist revision records; missing upstream counters are not invented. Empty selected populations yield zero; an observed population with no reported values yields NULL. Mixed populations sum only reported values.

functions.name: gist_files
functions.description: Current gist-qualified file dictionary entries, with exact filename key, typed nullable value, encoding and truncation. Raw URLs are descriptive and never followed automatically. A missing files object fails, while an empty object yields zero entries.

metrics.name: gist_file_entry_count
metrics.comment: Current gist file dictionary entries. A nullable file value remains an entry; this count does not assert complete file content.

gist_file_bytes.comment: Reported byte sizes for returned current file entries; NULL sizes remain unknown and are not inferred from truncated content. Empty selected populations yield zero; an observed population with no reported values yields NULL. Mixed populations sum only reported values.

functions.name: gist_star_observations
functions.description: Authenticated caller-qualified observations of gist star status. 204 means starred; 404 is the endpoint negative status and does not establish whether a target exists or is visible. Repeated invocations are current snapshots, not history.

metrics.name: gist_star_observation_count
metrics.comment: Current authenticated caller/gist star-status observations; not durable star-event history.

starred_gist_observation_count.comment: Observations for which GitHub returned the documented starred status. A 404 does not prove target existence or visibility.

routes.name: lookup

arguments.name: gist_id

routes.population: One current authenticated-caller star predicate for the exact requested target. No existence lookup precedes the predicate; 404 retains its documented negative status without asserting target existence.
